attributes.context: The same Article XVII (A)(3) provision defines substantial changes as real and justifiable, including changes to work methods, systems, machinery, equipment, sequence of operations, reduction of task, or relocation.

extraction_text: It is specifically understood and agreed (except for startup of new equipment or systems when larger than normal Crews may initially be needed) that Management may not take work of one classification and spread it among other classifications, for the purpose of permanently reducing the number of Employees, unless it does so by substantially changing the duties of existing job(s).

attributes.context: This clause is in the Wages section, which also provides that the Pine Bluff Mill basic hourly wage rate schedule for September 1, 1993 through August 31, 1998 is attached, remains in effect unless changed by mutual consent, and that wages are not subject to arbitration.

extraction_text: When major changes are made in the Pine Bluff Mill which creates new jobs, or substantially change the duties of existing jobs, the Management will meet with the Unions concerned to discuss the size of crews and appropriate rates of pay. Such meeting will take place 15 to 30 days before the start-up of the equipment unless the parties mutually agree that it is desirable to see the equipment in operation before discussing the crew size or rates of pay. The delay in holding this meeting is not to exceed 30 days.
